tool_input.command:
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(secret): thread keychain errors into the final not-found message (FIX 5)

secret.Get discarded every keychain backend error before falling through
to the file and environment backends -- `if val, err := keychainGet(name);
err == nil` never inspected a non-nil err at all. A key that IS correctly
stored but genuinely inaccessible (gpg-agent locked, D-Bus unavailable)
looked identical to "nothing stored there," so the resulting ErrNotFound
message sent an operator to re-insert a secret that was never missing.

The final "not found" message now names the keychain backend's own error
when one occurred, widening the fix to every secret.Get caller, not just
`beadle-daemon sign`'s passphrase resolution.

New regression test lives in keychain_linux_test.go, not secret_test.go:
it needs the passRunner/secretToolRunner seam that file already owns, and
that seam only exists on linux -- referencing it from a platform-agnostic
file would break a darwin build of the test binary.
EOF
)"
